name: CBZ Foundation

hero.title: Giving with purpose
hero.lede: The Group's philanthropic arm funds organisations working in public health, education and the support of vulnerable communities.

image.alt: Students at a school supported by the CBZ Foundation

about: The CBZ Foundation was established in March 2023 to bring the Group's charitable work under one roof. It is funded by an endowment of up to one percent of sustainable Group profit and makes grants to non-profit organisations in its three focus areas, with an initial grant pool of close to US$1 million.
